title: elytrigia × duvalii
intro: Elytrigia × duvalii, commonly known as Duval's wildrye, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of inflammatory conditions, pain relief, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Duval's wildrye include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Duval's wildrye have been shown to have potential therapeutic effects, including the inhibition of inflammatory enzymes and the scavenging of free radicals, making it a subject of interest for further research into its medicinal applications.
